summary: Netcapital Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a June 10, 2026 closing of a Securities Purchase Agreement with FirstFire Global Opportunities Fund. The company issued a $290,000 promissory note (purchase price $250,000, $40,000 OID) and a warrant to purchase 250,000 shares at $0.50/share. Net cash proceeds were $224,500 after fees. The unsecured note matures June 9, 2027, with amortization payments starting December 9, 2026. Interest is 12% ($34,800) earned upfront. This is a capital-raising through a structured note with warrant, not a transformative event. Watch for dilution from warrant exercise and note conversion.
